'''Matta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] owned by [[Dengula]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. She was a friend of [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], and the two often helped each other fulfill their work quotas.<ref name="GC">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref>
